changeSet.author: nexus-v4pj4
changeSet.comment: nexus.cross_preview_384: read-only twin of assign_from_chashes_384's cross branch -- same nearest-foreign-centroid LATERAL under the same HNSW/access-path pins, no persist.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.cross_preview_384( p_collection text, p_chashes text[] ) RETURNS TABLE( chash text, topic_id bigint, similarity double precision ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ #variable_conflict use_column BEGIN -- nexus-v4pj4: read-only twin of assign_from_chashes_384's cross -- branch (taxonomy-020-1). Same four transaction-local settings; -- see that changeset's header for the full reasoning. NEVER writes -- to topic_assignments. PERFORM set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true); PERFORM set_config('hnsw.ef_search', '400', true); PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true); PERFORM set_config('enable_sort', 'off', true);
RETURN QUERY WITH batch AS ( SELECT c.chash AS b_chash, c.embedding_384 AS b_emb FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.collection = p_collection AND c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ), nearest AS ( SELECT encode(b.b_chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, b.b_chash AS m_chash_bytes, n.n_topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - n.n_dist)::double precision AS m_sim FROM batch b CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ct.topic_id AS n_topic_id, (ct.embedding_384 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) b.b_emb) AS n_dist FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct WHERE ct.collection <> p_collection AND ct.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ct.embedding_384 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) b.b_emb, ct.topic_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) n ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, n.m_sim FROM nearest n; END; $fn$;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.cross_preview_384(text, text[]);
